explanation: The value is 0 at D1 and GO, at every step of trial 0, and nearly always 0 from about trial 8 onward (at most 1-2 at D2 after an unrewarded trial when a2 led to S2). It is only active at D2 in trials 1-7: 10 when the previous trial was unrewarded and the agent chose a2 and reached S2 (common), 7-9 for the same case a bit later or with a rare transition to S1, about 4-6 when the previous trial was unrewarded and it chose a1, and about 2-5 when the previous trial was rewarded.
